title: ON.energy big-number cards
description: Big, very rounded dark-grey cards on black, two per row (stacked on phones): a huge hairline-thin figure with a small raised unit in the top-right corner and a light title with grey copy at the bottom-left; one card can hold an illustration instead. Cards rise 60px and fade in as they scroll into view.
notes: media slot: an illustration (e.g. a dotted map) in a card with showMedia; empty, a muted panel of the same size stands in
the section has no top padding (it sits right under the section before); add pt-section when it stands alone
CSS only (view timeline); off under reduced motion
